critical_code_review_comments: corrections.py next_version() uses optimistic insert with DuplicateKeyError retry (5x) around append-only version increment - correct pattern for concurrent corrections on the same route.
corrections.correct() cleans up the correction record if next_version() throws (compensating delete) so a half-applied correction can't block future tries - good.
review.py attempt_review attaches corrections keyed by attempt_event_id and surfaces them in build_timeline so UI can hide Confirm/Edit/Dismiss when correction present.

known_for_review merges verified known entities from route_version with any additions from corrections (defensive) and places them on the trail for 3D/2D markers; items without depth correctly end up in 'Known objects without a position (not drawn)' list.

review.py /attempts/{id}/review response does NOT embed version_history/known_entities - frontend VersionHistory fetches /routes/{id}/history separately. This is clean separation but means two round-trips on review open; acceptable.

corrections.correct() looks up the vision frame via ev.for_event_id to compute depth-based position when the user confirms - good; dismiss path correctly keeps after=None and does not create a version.
default_note() in corrections.py falls back to 'route saved' for v1 and 'checkpoints edited' for later notes - matches UI copy on both the 3D review and route pages.
known_entities list filtered with isinstance(e, dict) in route_history guards against legacy string entries in route_versions - defensive and correct.
seed_data_creation: One temporary route 'TA temp (synthetic)' (copy of 2D demo route + v1 route_version) plus one exercise and one attempt created via API, used for route_version=1 / history / unknown-entity-remove 404 checks, then deleted via motor. Two earlier aborted test runs (before I fixed the response-shape handling) left orphan temp routes + exercises + attempts in Mongo; those were also deleted. Final DB tally restored to: routes=3, route_versions=3, attempts=3, exercises=3, corrections=1 matching the expected final data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 11 (corrections + route memory versions) verified end-to-end against public URL. Replay harness /app/tests/cue_policy_check.py replay = 34/34 deterministic. Demo attempts preserved: 48461db6-... (3D, has correction on event 4ed1bb84-... -> v2 'chair confirmed'), a59b1526-... (2D, no corrections). Correction testids used: version-history, version-history-v1, version-history-v2, known-entities-list, known-entity-<id>, timeline-item-<cue_id>. 'Saved to route memory as v2' label appears inside the timeline item when correction.new_route_version is set. Do NOT enable CUE_TEST_HOOK and do NOT run teach_walk_sim.py / review_demo.py build / memory_check (storage blobs non-deletable). When creating temp routes, note that POST /api/routes/{id}/exercises wraps response in {'exercise': {...}} and POST /api/exercises/{id}/attempts wraps in {'exercise':..., 'attempt': {...}} - use .get('attempt', body) when accessing route_version.
